key_insight: LLMs lose diagnostic accuracy when they must gather clinical information interactively rather than receive a complete case upfront.
clinical_relevance: Evaluating how models ask questions—not just how they interpret supplied evidence—is important before considering them for diagnostic workflows.
method: Introduced Hx2Dx ARENA with 1,000 simulated clinical encounters based on NEJM cases.
Modeled history taking, physical examination, and diagnostic workup.
Compared open- and closed-source LLMs across configurations and interactive versus static evaluations.
evidence_signal: Every evaluated model performed worse interactively than with the full case upfront, while more targeted questioning and a more complete clinical picture were associated with better diagnosis.
watch_item: Simulated-case performance does not establish real-world clinical safety, and limitations in hypothesis-driven information gathering remain a concern.
paper_title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
